AdvancedIntro.source: Adapter registration, app settings, offline model management and about — everything that is not part of the guided flow.

AdvancedModelsHint.source: Browse, download and install offline voices from the Voices tab — select the SherpaOnnx engine there.

AliasApplyNote.source: Applied whenever voices are installed or re-installed from the Voices tab. Existing voices pick the change up next time you install them.

AliasArabicHint.source: Voice in a right-to-left language (Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Hebrew, Pashto…) also appears under Arabic (ar-SA), so apps set up for Arabic voices can find it.

AliasArabicLabel.source: Also alias right-to-left voices under Arabic

AliasEnUsHint.source: Voice in any other language also appears as English (en-US), so apps that only list English voices — like some AAC titles — can use it.

AliasEnUsLabel.source: Add an en-US alias for non-English voices

AliasSettingsIntro.source: Voices are installed with their real language. Aliases add extra copies under a second language so apps that filter by language can still find them.

CredentialsFooterHint.source: Verify a key to check it works before loading voices. You can come back any time.

CredentialsIntro.source: Enter the credentials for each selected engine. Values are saved on this computer only.

DownloadFailedTitle.source: Download failed for {0}. Check your internet connection and try again — if it keeps failing, close other voice apps and restart VoiceGarden.

EdgeEngineDesc.source: Free Microsoft cloud voices in many languages. Best free online option — natural quality, no API key, needs internet.

EngineDescKeyOnly.source: {0} cloud voices. Needs an API key.

EngineDescKeyRegion.source: {0} cloud voices. Needs an API key and region.

EngineDescKeySecretRegion.source: {0} cloud voices. Needs an access key, secret key and region.

EngineDescKeyUserId.source: {0} cloud voices. Needs an API key and user ID.

LanguageFilterHiddenNote.source: {0} engines hidden — their languages are unknown until their voices are loaded in the Voices tab.

SherpaOnnxEngineDesc.source: Offline neural voices in many languages. Best for reliability and privacy — works without an account or internet once downloaded.

Step4Desc.source: Open the Voices tab and click Load voices. Filter by language, gender or quality, preview the ones you like, then use Download (offline models) and Install to SAPI. Installed voices appear in your apps straight away.

TabEnginesIntro.source: Choose the voice engines you want to use. Pick offline voices that work without an account, free cloud voices, or cloud engines that need an API key.

TabVoicesIntro.source: Every voice from the engines you selected. Filter, preview, then install the ones you want into Windows SAPI.

VerifyNoVoices.source: Key accepted but no voices returned — check the key has TTS access.

VoicesEmptyHint.source: Choose your voice engines in the Voice Engines tab first (add credentials there too if the engine needs a key), then load voices here.

VoicesEmptyNoEngines.source: No engines selected — open the Voice Engines tab and tick at least one engine.

VoicesMissingKey.source: {0}: no API key — add one in the Credentials tab

VoicesNoEnginesSelected.source: Select at least one engine in the Voice Engines tab first.

VoicesPromoteFailed.source: Could not install {0} (administrator approval may be required)

VoicesSkippedNoKey.source: {0} engines skipped — no API key set
